expected_behavior: With explicit urgency language and a laycan cancelling tomorrow, the parser must classify this CARGO_INQUIRY with urgency high (not medium/low).

input.subject: URGENT — firm offer COB today / coal Richards Bay - Mundra
input.body:
Dear Owners,

URGENT — laycan cancels tomorrow, we need a firm offer by COB today or charterers will go elsewhere.

- Cargo: steam coal in bulk
- Qty: abt 75,000 mt 10% moloo
- Load: 1sb Richards Bay
- Disch: 1sb Mundra
- Laycan: 30 May / 31 May (cancelling 31 May 2359 hrs)
- Load 45,000 / disch 25,000 mt shinc
- 2.5% addcomm + 1.25%

Kindly revert most urgently with firm freight per mt fio. This is time critical.

Best regards,
Sanjay Gupta
Meridian Chartering Pte Ltd
